svg.aria-label: Firewall: OPNsense running on a CloudGenix ION 3000, a rebranded Lanner FW-7573, with an Atom C2758 8-core CPU, 8 GB of memory, an 80 GB SSD and 14 gigabit ports. Front panel port map: WAN is igb12, the first Internet port, cabled to the ISR 4331 Gi0/0/0 at 192.168.50.2/30. LAN is a bridge of the eight module ports, igb2 to igb9, with igb5 cabled to the core switch Gi1/0/1 at 192.168.50.5/30; any module port can go to the core. The two Controller ports and the other three Internet ports are spare. How it became the firewall: the original CloudGenix SD-WAN system was wiped, UEFI boot was enabled in the BIOS, and OPNsense was installed fresh. What it does: stateful filtering, so nothing from the internet gets in unless it's a reply to a connection started inside, and Suricata IDS, which inspects traffic for known attack patterns and sends its alerts to Wazuh.
svg.title: Firewall
